title: 第25章 艾可失踪了她被人类抓走了第26章 愚蠢的修士
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
清晨，第一缕阳光透过斑驳的树叶，轻柔地洒在这片静谧的森林。女王的唇瓣微微颤动，仿佛一朵在微风中轻轻颤抖的娇艳花朵。她缓缓睁开那双深邃的眼眸，目光瞬间落在了正睡在她尾巴上的艾可身上。
“这个小淘气……”她的声音低沉而温柔，如同山间清澈的溪流，潺潺流淌，却又带着一丝无奈的宠溺。她凝视着艾可，眼神中充满了复杂的情感。艾可那小小的身躯蜷缩着，如同一个毛茸茸的小团子，安静而又依赖地依偎在她的尾巴上。
女王轻轻地叹了口气，那叹息声在寂静的空气中缓缓飘散。她倒也不怎么介意艾可的这般依赖，毕竟，被“需要”的感觉还不错，虽说这种需要有点怪。“难道她就这么喜欢软乎乎的东西？”她在心里自问，答案其实早已心知肚明。那答案如同深埋在心底的一颗种子，生根发芽，却又带着一丝甜蜜的无奈。
她微微仰头，望着头顶那片逐渐被阳光染亮的天空，心中暗自思忖：“我再等会儿就去打猎。”眼神中闪过一丝坚定。“她那么可爱又听话，就给她弄点好肉当作奖赏。这样才能让她一直乖乖巧巧的。”想到这里，她的嘴角不自觉地上扬，仿佛已经看到了艾可在品尝美味时那满足的神情。她自顾自地点了点头，像是在对自己的决定表示肯定。
……
女王迈着轻盈的步伐去打猎了，留下艾可独自一人。此时的森林，微风拂过，树叶沙沙作响，仿佛在低声诉说着什么。艾可或许觉得无聊，原本闪耀着神秘光芒的池塘，此刻也失去了它的魅力。不过那臭狐狸答应给她好肉还有更多的兽核，这让她充满了期待。就算死，她也不会离开这个地方，那些东西都美味得很，要是没有兽核疼得要命，可就难以弄到了。
……
“喂！”猎人一号愤怒地扇了猎人二号一巴掌，那手掌与脸颊接触的声音在寂静的山林中显得格外突兀。
“混蛋！”猎人一号嗤之以鼻，眉头紧皱，声音中充满了愤怒与指责。“你说那地方很近！”
“是很近。”猎人二号哼了一声，眼神中透着一丝不屑。“跟那些宗派比起来近多了。”
“该死”猎人一号咒骂道，那声音仿佛是从牙缝中挤出来的，充满了怨恨。“你就不能早点说？！”
“我早就说了！”猎人二号像看傻动物一样看着他的同伴，眼神中满是轻蔑与不耐烦。
“混蛋！”猎人一号朝猎人二号踢去，他的动作充满了力量与愤怒，然而这一次猎人二号灵活地躲开了，没踢着。
“省省力气！咱们得拿下那口灵气池塘！”猎人二号摇了摇头，看着这个冲动易怒的家伙，心中暗自叹息，此刻的他还想着要同伴的命，全然不顾此行的目的。
他们俩都是散修，在这茫茫世界中如浮萍般漂泊，资源少得可怜。为了在这弱肉强食的世上活下去，他们不得不学各种手艺。可作为散修，想要达到筑基期都难如登天。他们得给宗派留下好印象才能进去，因为他们已经过了洗脑的年龄要求，也没有足够的天赋从宗派最外围的地方起步。
许多人都称赞仙人超凡脱俗。他们从没见过仙人衣服上有灰尘或污渍。他们面容白皙，长发飘飘，令人羡慕不已。头发越长，地位越高。衣服越干净，威望越广。有些修士甚至吹嘘自己能在战斗时保持衣服干净，可惜，这些蠢货大多都被嫉妒的女修士给杀了。女修士比男修士更珍视自己的美貌，因为她们出风头的机会少得多。她们当然可以去炼丹什么的，这方面她们确实擅长，可谁不想脚踏飞剑在天空翱翔，对敌人施展出一招又一招的法术呢！
这就是为什么这些散修如此拼命。为了威望和美女。寿命越长，得到这些的机会就越大。然后他们就能在余生里逍遥快活了。
“嗯……”猎人一号沉默片刻，看着猎人二号。
“狐狸美女也不错啊。”他们俩都笑了起来，那笑声在山林中回荡，带着一丝贪婪与渴望，脚下的步伐也随之加快。
……

女王正在打猎，森林中的微风轻轻拂过她的身躯，带来阵阵清新的气息。这一切并不像她预想的那么难，似乎这片森林还没被人类涉足。她的脚步轻盈而敏捷，如同幽灵般穿梭在树林之间。每一次出手，都带着精准与果断。
因此，有很多动物可供她为她的小仆人猎杀。她站在自己猎杀的一堆尸体前，微微颔首，眼神中流露出一丝满意。她把它们都收进了戒指里，动作熟练而优雅。她还保管着艾可的戒指和袋子，因为那只懒小兽老是忘，或者一睡觉就会掉。
“她太没防备了……”女王叹了口气，就连她的小男宠都没这么没防备……至少她更可爱。她想起自己该做的事，慢慢地回到艾可身边。
……
当女王回到原地，却发现艾可……不在那儿。原本平静的池塘也消失了。虽说为了给她猎那些鸟花了她几天时间，但也不至于变化这么大。
她的心瞬间提到了嗓子眼，一种深深的恐惧和担忧如同冰冷的潮水般涌上心头。“小不点？！”她试着呼唤艾可，声音在空荡荡的森林中回荡，却没人回应。她的脑子变得沉重而迟钝，仿佛被一块巨大的石头压着。“迷魂粉。”她愤怒地咆哮，那声音如同雷霆万钧，震得周围的树叶纷纷落下。“那些该死的混蛋！”她的力量瞬间四处爆发，周围的空气都仿佛被点燃，充满了狂暴的气息。她想要和那些混蛋拼命，可惜她现在脑子不清醒，没能发现那股正从她身边逃离的奇怪能量。
“我要把你们都宰了！！！”她声嘶力竭地怒吼，那声音仿佛要撕裂这片天空。
然后她朝着那些脚印的方向冲去，可惜，那些是猎人设下的诱饵，好让他们能安全逃脱……
……
content_en:
In the early morning, the first ray of sunlight shines softly through the mottled leaves on this quiet forest. The queen's lips trembled slightly, like a delicate flower trembling gently in the breeze. She slowly opened her deep eyes, and her eyes instantly fell on Aike, who was sleeping on her tail.
"This little naughty..." Her voice was low and gentle, like a clear stream in the mountains, gurgling but with a hint of helpless doting. She stared at Aike, her eyes full of complicated emotions. Aike's little body was curled up like a fluffy little ball, nestling quietly and dependently on her tail.
The queen sighed softly, and the sigh slowly floated in the silent air. She didn't really mind Aiko's dependence on her. After all, it felt good to be "needed", although this kind of need was a bit strange. "Does she just like soft things so much?" She asked herself in her heart, and she already knew the answer. The answer is like a seed buried deep in my heart, taking root and sprouting, but with a hint of sweet helplessness.
She raised her head slightly, looking at the sky above her head that was gradually brightened by the sun, and thought to herself: "I'll go hunting in a little while." A trace of determination flashed in her eyes. "She is so cute and obedient, so let's get her some good meat as a reward. Only in this way can she always be well-behaved." Thinking of this, the corners of her mouth unconsciously raised, as if she had seen Ai Ke's satisfied expression when tasting the delicious food. She nodded to herself, as if affirming her decision.
…
The Queen went hunting with light steps, leaving Aiko alone. In the forest at this time, the breeze was blowing and the leaves were rustling, as if they were whispering something. Aike may feel bored. The pond that originally shone with mysterious light has lost its charm at this moment. However, the smelly fox promised to give her good meat and more animal cores, which made her full of expectations. Even if she died, she would not leave this place. Those things were very delicious, but it would be difficult to get them without the painful core of the beast.
…
"Hey!" Hunter No. 1 slapped Hunter No. 2 angrily. The sound of the palm touching the cheek was particularly abrupt in the silent mountain forest.
"Asshole!" Hunter No. 1 sneered, his brows furrowed, his voice full of anger and accusation. "You said that place is close!"
"It's very close." Hunter No. 2 snorted, with a trace of disdain in his eyes. "It's much closer than those sects."
"Damn" Hunter No. 1 cursed, the voice seemed to be squeezed out from between the teeth, full of resentment. "Couldn't you have said it earlier?!"
"I told you so!" Hunter No. 2 looked at his companion like a stupid animal, his eyes full of contempt and impatience.
"Bastard!" Hunter No. 1 kicked at Hunter No. 2. His movements were full of power and anger. However, this time Hunter No. 2 dodged nimbly and did not kick.
"Save your energy! We have to take down that aura pond!" Hunter No. 2 shook his head, looking at this impulsive and irritable guy, and sighed in his heart. At this moment, he was still thinking about killing his companions, completely ignoring the purpose of this trip.
Both of them are casual cultivators, drifting like duckweeds in this vast world with very few resources. In order to survive in this world where the weak eat the strong, they have to learn various crafts. But as a casual cultivator, it is difficult to reach the foundation building stage. They have to leave a good impression on the sect to get in, because they have passed the age requirement for brainwashing and do not have enough talent to start from the outermost reaches of the sect.
Many people praise the immortals as being extraordinary. They had never seen dust or stains on the clothes of the Rishi. Their fair faces and long flowing hair are enviable. The longer the hair, the higher the status. The cleaner the clothes, the greater the prestige. Some monks even boasted that they could maintain theirThe clothes were clean, but unfortunately, most of these idiots were killed by jealous female monks. Female monks value their beauty more than male monks because they have far less opportunity to be in the limelight. Of course they can make elixirs or something, and they are really good at this, but who doesn't want to fly in the sky with flying swords and cast spell after spell on the enemy!
This is why these casual cultivators are so desperate. For prestige and beauty. The longer you live, the greater your chances of getting these. Then they can live happily for the rest of their lives.
"Hmm..." Hunter 1 was silent for a moment and looked at Hunter 2.
"The fox beauty is not bad either." They both laughed. The laughter echoed in the mountains and forests, with a hint of greed and desire, and the pace under their feet also accelerated.
…
The queen was hunting, and the breeze in the forest gently blew over her body, bringing bursts of fresh breath. All this was not as difficult as she expected. It seemed that this forest had not been touched by humans yet. Her steps were light and agile, moving through the woods like a ghost. Every shot was made with precision and decisiveness.
So there are plenty of animals for her to hunt for her little servants. She stood in front of the pile of corpses she had hunted, nodding slightly, with a trace of satisfaction in her eyes. She collected them all into the ring, her movements deft and graceful. She also kept Echo's ring and bag because the lazy little beast always forgot about it or would drop it whenever he slept.
"She's so defenseless..." The Queen sighed, not even her little boy favorite was so defenseless... at least she was cuter. She remembered what she should do and slowly returned to Aiko.
…
When the queen returned to the original place, she found that Aike...wasn't there. The once peaceful pond also disappeared. Although it took her a few days to hunt those birds for her, it wouldn't have changed that much.
Her heart suddenly rose to her throat, and a deep fear and worry surged into her heart like a cold tide. "Little one?!" She tried to call Aike, her voice echoed in the empty forest, but no one responded. Her mind became heavy and sluggish, as if it were being weighed down by a huge stone. "Ecstasy powder." She roared angrily, and her voice was like thunder, causing the surrounding leaves to fall. "Those damn bastards!" Her power exploded everywhere instantly, and the air around her seemed to be ignited and filled with violent aura. She wanted to fight those bastards desperately, but unfortunately she was not clear-headed now and could not detect the strange energy that was escaping from her.
"I'm going to kill you all!!!" She roared at the top of her lungs, and her voice seemed to tear the sky apart.
Then she rushed in the direction of those footprints. Unfortunately, those were baits set by hunters so that they could escape safely...
…
